pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo Aciravatiyā nadiyā vesiyāhi saddhiṃ naggā ekatitthe nhāyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.4: kiṃ nu kho nāma ayye tumhākaṃ daharānaṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciṇṇena. nanu nāma kāmā paribhuñjitabbā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.5: yadā jiṇṇā bhavissatha tadā brahmacariyaṃ carissatha,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.6: evaṃ tumhākaṃ ubho antā pariggahitā bhavissantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.8: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo upassayaṃ gantvā bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.11: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.12: tena hi bhikkhave bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.15: evañ ca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc21:1.16.1: yā pana bhikkhunī naggā nhāyeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
